messages.content: Could Sarah Chen have approved a 15% NS-500 discount for Acme Manufacturing on 2025-09-23?

The 15% discount was commercially eligible: Acme’s agreement and pricing exception allowed up to 15% off NS-500 through March 31, 2028. [3][6] But the exception explicitly did not grant approval authority to any Northstar employee. [3]

The records show Sarah requested a 15% discount on September 16, 2025, and that request was marked approved by Sarah that day. [7] They do not establish whether Sarah had authority to approve it, so I can’t confirm that she *could* approve the discount on September 23.
